content: Rut loi Buazor deha
Naumir šuwami Elimelekor guštir ekzon ijjotdar tuwangor egena aššil; tãir nam Buaz.
Ek dinna Muabiya Rute Naumire hodde: Ãi ketor kuṛat zaiore ze ãre rahamotor nozore giudanar sóra feṛaito de, tar fise fise giudanar sóra feṛaigoi. Naumi hoil: Okena, za oh zi.

Bade hiba zaiore ek ketor kuṛat fošol haṛoya okkolor fise fise kuṛat foijjia giudanar sóra okkol feṛailowa šuru goijjil. Ar endilla oilo, ze kuṛat Rute giudana feṛail hiyan Elimelekor egena Buazor ket.
Ar so, Buaz Betlehemottu aišše edde fošol haṛoya okkolore hoil: Mabud tũwarar fũwati takok. Tara zuwabe hoil: Mabud õnore o duwa gorok.
Bade Buaz fošol haṛoya okkolor uwore zimmadarore fusar goijjil, Iba haro zobuti? hoi.
Tehon zimmadare hoil: Iba Muabiya zobuti, ze Naumir fũwati Muab dešottu aišše.

Hibaye ãttu fusargoijjil, meherbanigori fošol haṛoya okkolor fise fise zai kuṛattu giudanar sóra feṛai loifaijjum ne hoi. Hiba binna loti ehon foijjonto eṛe ase; bana ekkenagori góror butore aiššil edde zirail.
Toi Buaz Rutore hoil: Fun; oh ãr maya fuwa, tui giudana feṛaito oinno ketot no zais, ei ketottu no zaisgoi, ãr zobuti bandi okkolor fũwati eṛe tak.

Fošol haṛoya okkol zeṛe fošol haṛibo hikka diyan raki tui bandi okkolor fise fise zais. Tor gat hat no defan ãi zobuk okkolore hoidir. Ar fanir tirašlagile tui oi górar hãse zai, zobuk okkole ze fani tuli raikke henttu fihaisgoi.
Henot hibaye meṛit sojida fori tare salam gori hoil: Ãi boideši, õne ãre eto faṭṭa dor, õnor sarme ãi ei doya kiyottu failamde?
Buaze zuwab dil: "Tor šuwami mori bade tui tor horire zendilla goijjios edde nizor ma bab, zormostan sari ek osin zatir hãse aiššos, he šob hota beggun ãi fuinni.
Mabude tore, tui zin goijjos hinor enam dok; He Israilor Allah, Mabudor fakor nise zehon tui assoro loito aiššos, hibaye tore furafuri bafe enam dok."
Hibaye Buazore hoil: "Oh ãr malik, õne ãre rahamotor nozore so; õnor ei bandire šantona dila edde šantir hota hoila, zodi o ãi õnor bandi okkolor laikka no."

Tarfore hána háibar ṭaim zẽtte oil Buaze hibare hoil: Tui eṛe ai ruṭi hagai, tor ruṭir ṭukura rošot burai lo. Bade hibaye fošol haṛoya okkolor ḍakottu boiššil, ar Buaze hibare baijja dana dil. Toi hibaye feṭbori hána háil. bade aro hodun basitaigilgoi.
Bade hiba giudana feṛaito zehon uṛil, Buaz tar mainšore hokum dil: Hibare dolagoijjattu feṛailoito do, edde hibare hũnki no diba hoi.
Oh, tũwara hodun giudanar tarattu ṭani hiballa raki do, zene hiba feṛailoi fare, ar honokiye hibare dõk no diba.
Ar hibaye hazinna foijjonto he ketot giudana feṛail. Bade hibar feṛaiya giudana hinore baijjaiore onumanik ek ari foijjonto giudana oil.
Bade hibaye hin tuliloi šohorot uwafes firigilgoi. Horiye hibar feṛaiya giudanar bosta dekil; ar Rute basitakkilde he hánagun o hibar fũwati loiannil, ar hinore hibar horir munttu niyolaidil.

Tehon horiye hibare hoil: Tui aijjia hoṛe feṛaios? Hoṛe ham goijjos? Ze tor mikka rahamotor nozor diye, Allah tare rahamot gorok. Tehon hibaye har hãse ham goijje, hin horire zanail. Hibaye endilla hoil: Ze manušwar hãse aijjia ãi ham goijji tar nam Buaz.

Henot Naumi hibar futor boure hoil: Tare rahamot gorok he Mabude ze doya deha bondogori no fele zinda edde mora okkolor uwore. Naumi aro hoil: Hite ãrar egena, ãrare dehašuna goribar zimma asede tarar butorottu ekzon.
Ar Muabiya Rute hoil: Te ãre endilla o hoiye, ãr šomosto fošol daiya šeš no o foijjonto tui ãr mainšor fũwati fũwati takis.
Tehon Naumi hibar futor boure hoil: Mare, oinno honokiyor ketot, tore honokiye zalafura gori no farefan, tar hamor mayafuwaindor fũwati fũwati takon tolla bala oibo.
Toi fošol daiya šeš no o foijjonto, hibaye giudana feṛaibolla Buazor hamor mayafuwaindor fũwati fũwati takil edde hibar horir fũwati bošobaš goijil.
